description: Unit test class for ImmutableResource in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package. The test verifies immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructor validation for ImmutableResource objects.

classes.name: ImmutableResourceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ImmutableResource class, focusing on immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructor validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableResource and its related types are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableResource has correctly implemented hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: testToAndFromJson
methods.description: Tests serialization of ImmutableResource to JSON and deserialization back, asserting object equality.

methods.name: createResourceSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful creation of an ImmutableResource with valid parameters.

methods.name: createResourceWithJsonValueNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as JsonValue throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createResourceWithEffectedPermissionsNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as EffectedPermissions throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createResourceWithJsonValueInvalidType
methods.description: Ensures that providing an invalid JSON type throws DittoJsonException.

methods.name: createResourceWithJsonValueMissingFields
methods.description: Ensures that a JSON object missing required fields throws DittoJsonException.

methods.name: createResourceWithJsonValueSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful creation of ImmutableResource from a valid JSON representation.
